data_policy: Aggregate metrics only. No upstream-derived task records, OCR, images, answers, page IDs, model completions, or checkpoints are redistributed.

scope.private_development_context: A private development harness supported retrieval, page opening, crop, OCR, and answer/evidence operations; it is not part of this public controlled-experiment release.
scope.reported_v1_v2_policy: Controlled answer/evidence JSON selection after a deterministic controller retrieves and OCRs all five candidates.
not_measured_by_v1_v2: learned retrieval, open, crop, or OCR behavior

greedy_metric_definitions.answer_correct: The generated answer matches an accepted answer.
greedy_metric_definitions.evidence_hit: The generated evidence_page equals the GT evidence page.
greedy_metric_definitions.grounded_correct: Both answer_correct and evidence_hit are true.

v1_clean.split_contract: Constructed from the official source train/test split with zero selected candidate-page overlap across post-training and evaluation.
v1_clean.task_contract: English question; OCR-verifiable GT; 1 GT + 4 hard negatives; no selected negative OCR contains an accepted answer.

training_signal.informative_group_definition: For one training prompt, reward_std > 0 across its 8 sampled rollouts; only then can group-relative GRPO form non-zero relative advantages.

v2_answer_leak.split_contract: Constructed from the official source train/test split with zero selected candidate-page overlap across post-training and evaluation.
v2_answer_leak.task_contract: English question; OCR-verifiable GT; 1 GT + at least 1 non-GT answer-leak candidate + hard negatives; a selected leak ties or outranks GT BM25.

training_signal.informative_group_definition: For one training prompt, reward_std > 0 across its 8 sampled rollouts; only then can group-relative GRPO form non-zero relative advantages.

teacher_forced_diagnostic_vs_base.margin_definition: log P(GT evidence_page | prompt, canonical answer) - log P(best answer-leak evidence_page | prompt, canonical answer)
teacher_forced_diagnostic_vs_base.caveat: Conditioned on a canonical answer; not a joint generated-trajectory probability.

fixed_seed_sampling.joint_output_definition: One sampled output contains a generated answer and evidence_page JSON pair after the fixed OCR controller.
fixed_seed_sampling.grounded_success_at_8_definition: A task succeeds if at least one of its eight sampled joint outputs is grounded_correct.
fixed_seed_sampling.correct_answer_with_leak_evidence_defini: The generated answer is accepted while the selected evidence_page is a non-GT answer-leak candidate.

task_block_bootstrap_grounded_delta_vs_b.caveat: Resamples tasks, not independent training seeds.

supported_conclusion: Evidence-aware reward increased the fraction of rollout groups with non-zero within-group reward variation in both one-seed controlled runs; V2 shows only a small, non-conclusive fixed-seed sampled policy shift and no improvement in Grounded Success@8 or greedy grounded performance.
unsupported_claims: statistically reliable accuracy or grounding improvement
causal evidence that outcome-only GRPO preferentially exploits answer leaks
